seo.title: Aluminum Weight Calculator - Sheet & Plate
seo.description: Aluminum Weight Calculator — Calculate the weight of aluminum parts including sheets, plates, and extrusions with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Weight = L × W × T × ρ. Aluminum density = 2700 kg/m³ (about 1/3 the weight of steel).

content.introduction: Calculate the weight of aluminum sheets, plates, and flat parts. Aluminum density is 2700 kg/m³ — roughly one-third of steel, making it ideal for lightweight structures.

faq.a: Pure aluminum is 2700 kg/m³. Aluminum alloys range from 2640 to 2850 kg/m³ depending on alloying elements.

faq.q: How much lighter is aluminum than steel?
faq.a: Aluminum is about 65% lighter than carbon steel for the same volume (2700 vs 7850 kg/m³).
